data.one_liner: Flutter SDK for Better Auth providing email/password, social sign‑in, session management and reactive auth state.
data.what_it_does: It wraps Better Auth's REST API with a Dio client, handling authentication flows, cookie or bearer sessions, and exposing a sealed Result type for all calls. It also offers Riverpod 3 providers and streams to reactively track auth state.
use_when: You need a custom backend authentication solution rather than Firebase or Supabase
You want reactive auth state with Riverpod or Stream listeners
You require secure cookie‑based sessions across platforms
avoid_when: You only need simple OAuth with Google/Apple and don't need a full backend
You prefer a fully managed BaaS like Firebase
strengths: Unified API for email, password, social and passkey auth
Reactive auth state via streams and Riverpod providers
Secure cookie storage with automatic persistence
weaknesses: Tied to Better Auth backend; not a generic OAuth library
Requires manual setup of the Better Auth server
No code generation; models must be maintained manually
data.setup_notes: Add the package, call BetterAuthFlutter.initialize with your server URL before runApp; no native permissions required

alternatives.name: firebase_auth
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides similar auth features with a fully managed backend and extensive Firebase ecosystem

alternatives.name: google_sign_in
alternatives.why_pick_it: Simpler if you only need Google OAuth without a custom backend

alternatives.why_pick_it: Dedicated Apple sign‑in without needing the full Better Auth server
